summary: FiscalNote Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 22, 2026, disclosing amendments to forbearance agreements with subordinated creditors GPO FN Noteholder, LLC and YA II PN, Ltd. The amendments waive defaults triggered by the delisting of its Class A common stock from the NYSE and extend the forbearance period to August 22, 2026. No financial terms, consideration, or advisors are specified. The filing indicates ongoing credit distress and a temporary standstill, suggesting a restructuring or potential capital raise. Watch for further extensions or a comprehensive out-of-court restructuring or Chapter 11 filing before the new deadline.
